evals.name: cold-start-full-plan
evals.prompt: Run sprint planning for September. My priorities in order are: 1) contradictory/de-duplication, 2) Azure Networking TOC and content reboot, 3) retrievability/AEO, 4) fact-checker delivery, 5) content updates and gap analysis.
evals.expected_output: Board snapshot for September and October with point totals, a velocity baseline from prior sprints, 5-6 grounded interview questions naming real work item IDs and point values, an anti-pattern scan, and a change list presented for approval before any ADO write.

evals.name: anti-pattern-detection-only
evals.prompt: Check my August sprint for planning problems. Don't change anything.
evals.expected_output: All six anti-pattern checks run and reported, with specific work item IDs. No ADO writes attempted. Findings presented as flags requiring a decision, not auto-fixed.

evals.name: mid-sprint-rescope
evals.prompt: I just picked up a new service and I'm leading stakeholder comms now. What comes out of this month?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this as a re-plan rather than a fresh sprint. Pulls current board, quantifies overhead as a capacity reserve, proposes specific items to defer with point values and reasons, checks whether the receiving sprint has room, and asks before applying.

evals.name: one-pager-from-existing-plan
evals.prompt: Build me a one-pager for this sprint I can share with my manager.
evals.expected_output: Generates both markdown and themed HTML in the configured output directory. Includes masthead, ordered priorities with points, capacity math against velocity, dated commitments with dependency gates, risks, and a Net summary. Point totals reconcile with the live board.

evals.name: dated-commitment-gap
evals.prompt: I need to deliver fact-checker results by 10/15. Is my plan set up for that?
evals.expected_output: Detects whether a work item exists with that target date. If not, flags it as the highest-severity finding, traces the upstream dependency chain across sprints, and identifies which sprint is the actual constraint.
